Talia (new-hire): hey everyone, first week onboarding question — my redis service in compose keeps restarting with `OOMKilled` and the app can’t connect. running macOS Ventura + Docker Desktop. Anyone seen this?

Ben (infra): welcome Talia :wave: OOMKilled usually means the container hit its memory limit. Check `docker compose ps` and `docker stats` to see memory. What image and args are you using for redis?

Talia (new-hire): redis:6.2-alpine, no special command in the compose file. `docker compose stats` shows redis using ~1.2GiB and then it restarts. My laptop has 8GB and Docker Desktop is set to 2GB memory in settings.

Marta (backend): ah there you go — Docker Desktop memory cap is low. Redis persistence (AOF/RDB) plus default maxmemory settings can push it past small caps. Either increase Docker memory to like 4GB or configure redis `maxmemory` lower in dev. For dev we usually bind-mount a local redis.conf in compose which sets `maxmemory 256mb` and `maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru`.

Ben (infra): also check whether you have other containers hogging memory (chrome + IDE + db). Quick workaround: in compose override add:
```yaml
services:
  redis:
    command: ["redis-server", "/usr/local/etc/redis/redis.conf"]
    volumes:
      - ./dev/redis/redis.conf:/usr/local/etc/redis/redis.conf:ro
```
And create `dev/redis/redis.conf` with:
```
maxmemory 256mb
maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru
save ""
appendonly no
```
Disabling persistence avoids big spikes for dev.

Talia (new-hire): thanks — I don’t want to change Docker settings since I share the laptop. I added the redis.conf and updated compose override. `docker compose up` keeps it up now.

docs-bot: Suggested docs edit: Add 'Redis dev config' section to onboarding README. Would you like to create the PR?

Talia (new-hire): yup, I will add a short snippet and the exact commands I ran. Thanks for the quick help!
